mapper.sql: select s.score_id as scoreId, s.student_id as studentId, st.student_name as studentName, st.class_id as classId, cl.class_name as className, co.course_id as courseId, co.course_name as courseName, co.credit as credit, co.course_type as courseType, s.term as term, s.usual_score as usualScore, s.final_score as finalScore, s.total_score as totalScore, s.gpa as gpa, s.manual_total as manualTotal, s.recorder_id as recorderId, date_format(s.record_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as recordTime, case when exists ( select 1 from edu_appeal a where a.student_id = s.student_id and a.course_id = s.course_id and a.term = s.term and a.status = 'PENDING' ) then 'APPEALING' when exists ( select 1 from edu_score_change_log l where l.student_id = s.student_id and l.course_id = s.course_id ) then 'MODIFIED' else 'NORMAL' end as status from edu_score s join edu_student st on st.student_id = s.student_id join edu_classroom cl on cl.class_id = st.class_id join edu_course co on co.course_id = s.course_id

select score_id as scoreId, student_id as studentId, course_id as courseId, term as term, usual_score as usualScore, final_score as finalScore, total_score as totalScore, gpa as gpa, manual_total as manualTotal, recorder_id as recorderId from edu_score
mapper.select: select class_id from edu_student where student_id = #{studentId} and status = '0' limit 1

select st.student_id as studentId, st.student_name as name, st.class_id as classId, cl.class_name as className, s.score_id as scoreId, s.usual_score as usualScore, s.final_score as finalScore, s.total_score as totalScore, case when s.score_id is null then 0 else 1 end as recorded from edu_student st join edu_classroom cl on cl.class_id = st.class_id left join edu_score s on s.student_id = st.student_id and s.course_id = #{courseId} and s.term = #{term} where st.class_id = #{classId} and st.status = '0' order by st.student_id

select l.log_id as logId, l.score_id as scoreId, l.student_id as studentId, st.student_name as studentName, l.course_id as courseId, co.course_name as courseName, l.term as term, l.old_usual as oldUsual, l.old_final as oldFinal, l.old_total as oldTotal, l.new_usual as newUsual, l.new_final as newFinal, l.new_total as newTotal, l.change_reason as changeReason, l.operator_id as operatorId, t.teacher_name as operatorName, date_format(l.operate_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as operateTime, l.source as source from edu_score_change_log l left join edu_student st on st.student_id = l.student_id left join edu_course co on co.course_id = l.course_id left join edu_teacher t on t.teacher_id = l.operator_id where l.score_id = #{scoreId} order by l.operate_time desc, l.log_id desc
mapper.insert: insert into edu_score (score_id, student_id, course_id, term, usual_score, final_score, total_score, gpa, manual_total, recorder_id, record_time, create_by, create_time) values (#{scoreId}, #{studentId}, #{courseId}, #{term}, #{usualScore,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{finalScore,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{totalScore,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{gpa,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, '0', #{recorderId}, now(), #{recorderId}, now())
mapper.update: update edu_score set usual_score = #{usualScore,jdbcType=INTEGER}, final_score = #{finalScore,jdbcType=INTEGER}, total_score = #{totalScore,jdbcType=INTEGER}, gpa = #{gpa,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, manual_total = '0', update_by = #{operatorId}, update_time = now() where score_id = #{scoreId}
update edu_score set total_score = #{totalScore,jdbcType=INTEGER}, gpa = #{gpa,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, manual_total = '1', update_by = #{operatorId}, update_time = now() where score_id = #{scoreId}
mapper.insert: insert into edu_score_change_log (log_id, score_id, student_id, course_id, term, old_usual, old_final, old_total, new_usual, new_final, new_total, change_reason, operator_id, operate_time, source, create_by, create_time) values (#{logId}, #{scoreId}, #{studentId}, #{courseId}, #{term}, #{oldUsual,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{oldFinal,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{oldTotal,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{newUsual,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{newFinal,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{newTotal,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{changeReason}, #{operatorId}, now(), #{source}, #{operatorId}, now())
